title: Integrate full editor UI components layout and resizable window
description:
Wire all UI components into the plugin editor and register the new UI sources in the build. Update Source/PluginEditor.h and Source/PluginEditor.cpp so the editor: instantiates and applies ShredLookAndFeel; creates and lays out TransferCurveScope, SpectrumOverlay, and LevelMeters plus the parameter rotaries; connects every parameter control to the APVTS via SliderAttachment/ButtonAttachment/ComboBoxAttachment; adds a gain-matched bypass button bound to the bypass parameter; and makes the window resizable (setResizable with a constrainer / sensible min/max, laying out in resized()). Pass the processor's atomic/FIFO telemetry handles into the scope, spectrum, and meter components. Update CMakeLists.txt to add all Source/UI/*.cpp files (ShredLookAndFeel, TransferCurveScope, SpectrumOverlay, LevelMeters) to the target sources. GUI code must only read atomic telemetry / lock-free FIFOs; it must never lock or block the audio thread.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/UI/ShredLookAndFeel.h, Source/UI/TransferCurveScope.h, Source/UI/SpectrumOverlay.h, Source/UI/LevelMeters.h (public APIs produced by g.1-g.4)
- Source/PluginProcessor.h (APVTS accessor, parameter IDs, and telemetry handles to bind)
- Source/PluginEditor.h and Source/PluginEditor.cpp (current editor structure)
- CMakeLists.txt (existing target sources block and Source/UI file list)
acceptance_criteria: Source/PluginEditor.cpp instantiates ShredLookAndFeel, TransferCurveScope, SpectrumOverlay, and LevelMeters and lays them out in resized()
Every parameter control is connected to the APVTS via an attachment and a gain-matched bypass button is bound to the bypass parameter
The editor window is resizable via setResizable with a bounded constrainer
CMakeLists.txt lists Source/UI/ShredLookAndFeel.cpp, Source/UI/TransferCurveScope.cpp, Source/UI/SpectrumOverlay.cpp, and Source/UI/LevelMeters.cpp in the target sources
cmake -S . -B build succeeds and cmake --build build --target ShredBoost_VST3 succeeds
No file outside this task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify the Source/UI component files created in g.1-g.4
lock, block, or call the audio thread from GUI code
